# PDF fixtures

Generated by `make_pdfs.py` (`uv run python tests/fixtures/pdf/make_pdfs.py`), a small PDF writer of
our own: no clock, no randomness, no third-party library, deflate written by hand, so the bytes are the
same on every host. `tests/unit/adapters/test_pdf_fixtures.py` checks the committed files against it.
Expected outcomes are asserted in `tests/unit/adapters/test_pdf_adapter.py`.

| File | Case | What the `pdf` adapter must do |
|---|---|---|
| `pump_sop.pdf` | tagged SOP, 2 pages: H1, P, list, figure, caption, H2, table (TH row, an empty cell), RoleMap, header/footer artifacts, page labels `i`, `A-1` | roles and levels from tags; a table block, a `StructuredTable` and two rows; header/footer blocks; regions from Core 14 and declared widths |
| `gripper_datasheet.pdf` | untagged datasheet: `TJ` kerning and spacing, `T*`, `'`, `"`, scaled text, a form drawn twice, an inline image and an image XObject; page 2 rotated 90 with a CID font (Identity-H, ToUnicode, `W`) and a `Differences` font with an unknown glyph name | a block per run in content order, `Unknown` roles, figure blocks; the unknown glyph's block has `Unknown` text and region plus findings |
| `renamed_datasheet` | the datasheet without an extension | selected from its bytes |
| `site_manifest.pdf` | object streams, an xref stream, an incremental update that retitles it | the update's title |
| `inspection_log.pdf` | catalog first, a long second page | baseline for `truncated.pdf` |
| `blank.pdf` | one declared page, no content | one page, no blocks |
| `empty.pdf` | zero bytes | `pdf.unreadable` |
| `truncated.pdf` | the inspection log cut inside page 2's content: no xref, no trailer | rebuilt (`pdf.repaired`): page 1 read, page 2 `pdf.content_unreadable` |
| `corrupted.pdf` | the datasheet with page 1's content stream damaged | page 1 `pdf.content_unreadable`, page 2 read |
| `encrypted_user.pdf` | RC4 128 with a user password | pages listed, `pdf.encrypted`, no text |
| `encrypted_owner.pdf` | RC4 128, empty user password | read like `pump_sop.pdf` |
| `encrypted_aes.pdf` | declares AESV2 | `pdf.encrypted`, never decrypted |
| `hostile_nesting.pdf` | arrays nested 50,000 deep in content and in `/Info` | `pdf.content_unreadable` (page 1 kept up to the nesting), `pdf.value_unreadable`; page 2 read |
| `hostile_bomb.pdf` | page content inflating to 24 MiB of spaces | `pdf.content_limit`; page 2 read |
| `hostile_active.pdf` | JavaScript on open, on a page and in the name tree; an embedded file | `pdf.javascript`, `pdf.embedded_files`; text read, nothing run |
| `hostile_xref.pdf` | an xref section claiming two billion entries, a `/Prev` loop | rebuilt (`pdf.repaired`) |
| `hostile_pages.pdf` | a page tree whose kid is itself | `pdf.unreadable` |
| `hostile_objstm.pdf` | an object stream declaring 100,000,000 objects | read, `pdf.repaired` |
